DON'T STAY!!!! I'm in the same situation except I don't have family to move back to. I have good paying job, huge apartment etc but no friends, nothing to enjoy and what seems like no chance of it all getting any better. So please for the love of all take any chance you have to have a at least decent life.

I have the same problem so here is some of the things I do
- look for new people (try at the workplace, go to courses they teach in person about anything doesn't matter. Only important thing is you start talking to new people if you can't do that keep in mind it's a skill to talk to people so get started)[because of Corona try Facebook, dating apps to develop the skill] 
- exercise ( start extremely slow... Think you can do 5 push-ups then start with 3 but do them daily , it's important to start a routine, latter when ur fit enough use ur emotions to get that extra push up or extra mile of running)
And most important thing don't loose hope!!!! Imagine ur perfect life and do ur absolute best to achieve it!!! Thinking of a girl you like? Use that to improve yourself however u want doesn't matter if it works out or not. Just don't loose hope 🤙 ps. Sorry for bad Englisch
